svg.title: Blue Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Schematic oblique installation view; floor trapezoid represents perspective, not plan geometry. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/blue-red/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
